metadata.description: jevmem: automatic project memory for Cursor. One plugin: hooks that save each finished agent turn, an MCP server that brings memory back, and the rule that tells the agent to ask for it.

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.description: Say it once. jevmem saves the decisions, rules and failed approaches from your Cursor chats to JEVMEM.md in your repo, and brings the relevant ones back when the agent asks. Needs the jevmem CLI from npm and a TypeSafe API key. Opt-in per project: silent elsewhere.
